thread:
Sam: FYI — need a quick alignment on the Cypress enterprise POC timeline. Sales asked for a concise milestone list, owners, and any blockers we expect from eng/infra side. Can folks confirm?

Maria: @Sam I can own the SE side — will coordinate test plan + success criteria. Quick Q: do we need end-to-end SSO or token-based auth for the POC?

Tony: Sales said they'd prefer SSO, but they can accept token-based if SSO is a showstopper. Acceptance criteria: (1) sample integration sending requests at 100 rps for 5m, (2) system logs + latency <200ms p95 for gen API, (3) data retention off by default.

Alex: Engineering notes: we can support token-based immediately. SSO requires SAML config and a short infra change for our Private offering — estimate 2 weeks. Token flow: share API key scoped to trial; sample code below.

Alex: ```bash
# curl example for token flow
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate
```

Maria: Good, let's default POC to token flow to hit timelines. If they request SSO during POC, log it as a feature request and scope separately.

Zoe: From solutions side: integration deliverables we can demo to customer: webhook callbacks, streaming responses, and a configured sample app that reproduces their data shape. Who's owning the sample app?

Alex: I can own the sample app repo and stubbed webhook handler. Need someone to validate their payload schema.

Sam: @Tony can you confirm the customer's expected payload format and share a sample by EOD today?

Tony: I will. Also, sales requested a short timeline for onboarding — propose: Week 1: token POC + sample app, Week 2: performance run + analytics, Week 3: optional SSO work or handoff to Dedicated. Thoughts?

Jen: SRE note: for the performance run we need an allowlist IP or temp VPN to avoid rate limiting and to pin traffic to the Dedicated pool. If we use hosted, we'll need to provision quota and a canary route. Estimated infra task ~1 day.

Maria: Ok adding success criteria checklist for the POC (will own verification):
- [ ] Integration demo works with sample app
- [ ] p95 latency <200ms under 100 rps
- [ ] No PII persisted; data retention off
- [ ] Webhook events delivered within 2s 95% of the time
- [ ] Clear next-step doc (SSO plan / Dedicated sizing)

Sam: Owners: Maria (SE) — success criteria, Alex (Eng) — sample app + webhook, Jen (SRE) — infra for perf run, Tony (Sales) — customer payload + timelines, Zoe (Solutions) — demo script & runbook.

Zoe: I'll draft the demo script and post in this thread by tomorrow morning.

Alex: Blockers: need the customer's payload + decision on whether they want streaming enabled. If they want streaming, small SDK tweak may be needed (1-2 days).

Tony: I'll get the payload and confirm streaming preference.

deploy-bot: Reminder — create a temporary namespace for cypress-poc before the perf run. ETA creation window: 10-15m after request.

Sam: Great. Action items recap: Tony share payload by EOD, Zoe demo script by tomorrow a.m., Alex start sample app stub, Jen schedule infra prep for perf, Maria finalize checklist. Will circle back Fri for status. :thumbsup:
